mutator.name: libredwg_dxf_uaf_a001
mutator.strategy: 50% libFuzzer default; 50% a001: inside 2/OBJECTS replace a Seed-random code-0 record's value line with a Seed-derived random name, or insert a complete OBJECTS section before 0/EOF when absent.

biases.code_hint: random_k over code-0 records inside 2/OBJECTS; Seed-derived name length 1..64 from alphabet; construct before 0/EOF when section absent

limits: Plan only guarantees record-level DXF location, not byte offsets; implementation scans code/value pairs and 2/OBJECTS boundaries.

If MaxSize is too small for the required replacement or section insertion, the strategy returns the original input as required by the failure rule; section-absent insertion cannot mutate in that edge case.
For non-CRLF inputs, replacement preserves the local line ending of the edited value line; constructed sections always use CRLF as specified by construct.line_endings.
If OBJECTS exists but contains no eligible code-0 object value line, the strategy returns original rather than inventing a new insertion path not present in the plan.
